latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Image to Video for YouTube — Convert Photos into YouTube Videos.

- Instantly convert uploaded photos to ready-to-post YouTube videos (up to 1080p MP4) with transitions and background music.
- No manual editing required; simply upload images and describe your desired outcome.
- Automatic setup handles authentication and session creation for you, using free or provided tokens.
- Supports common image formats (JPG, PNG, WEBP, HEIC) up to 200MB, and exports in widely-used video formats.
- Built-in error handling for common issues (unsupported file types, session/auth problems, export restrictions).
- Optimized for YouTubers and fast batch processing—turn collections of photos into full videos with ease.
